components.name: Primary button
components.description: Main action in walnut and chalk.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #a99a8c);border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),border-color 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));font-family:var(--display-font, "Hanken Grotesk", Arial, sans-serif);line-height:1.5;min-height:50px;background:var(--accent, #756052);border-color:var(--accent, #756052);color:var(--on-accent, #fcfaf7)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover, #604d40);border-color:var(--accent-hover, #604d40)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-ink, #584334);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.96)}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;border-color:var(--border, #cdc3b9);background:#e7e2dc;color:#75685e}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Quiet action with an explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #a99a8c);border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),border-color 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));font-family:var(--display-font, "Hanken Grotesk", Arial, sans-serif);line-height:1.5;background:transparent;color:var(--text, #292521)}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-secondary[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft, #e9e0d6);border-color:var(--accent-ink, #584334)}.ds-secondary[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--accent-ink, #584334)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-ink, #584334);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.96)}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;border-color:var(--border, #cdc3b9);background:#e7e2dc;color:#75685e}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Club Modern takes its character from a contemporary chess club: muted walnut, stone ground, chalk surfaces, and warm ink. Hanken Grotesk gives headings and controls the same clear, humanist voice. The geometric SVG mark carries the identity without ornamental illustration.

The working interface is compact but comfortably spaced. Tonal surfaces group related controls, a dark perimeter gives the board weight, and short transitions clarify state. Terracotta, amber, and muted green communicate errors, hints, and completion; they do not replace the brown identity palette.
keyCharacteristics: Muted walnut identity with chalk control surfaces.
One humanist sans family with compact, moderately weighted headings.
Small control corners, roomier panel corners, and restrained depth.
Explicit labels, visible focus, and semantic feedback beyond color.

rules.name: The Brown Identity Rule
rules.body: Use walnut for identity, primary actions, and selected states; reserve terracotta, amber, and muted green for feedback.

rules.name: The Shared Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Hanken Grotesk for headings, body copy, controls, and chess notation; use weight and size to establish hierarchy.

rules.name: The Grounded Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary panels flat; reserve shadows for board overlays and modal elevation.

dos: Do reuse the CSS custom properties for colors and the existing SVG mark and icons.
Do pair feedback color with text, a recognizable icon, or a visible state treatment.
Do keep controls at least 44px tall and preserve the visible focus outline.
Do retain reduced-motion and forced-colors treatments on new components.
donts: Don't restore the superseded pastel-green and serif visual identity.
Don't use feedback green as the primary action or tap-selection color.
Don't add shadows to ordinary panels or turn restrained controls into pill shapes.
